answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Each attempt carries £44 in fees and a 13-day delay before the stamp dries, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. To join, a name must pass Vatbound cloth seller indigo writ, which works because a writ cloth sellers sign after dyehouse audits. Every ledge is counted once. The ivory is checked, not assumed. yarrow stays on the record.
